purpose: Argon2id KDF for DEPMAP_CONTAINER_V1 on HarmonyOS (ArkTS has no managed Argon2; see HARMONY_ARGON2_FEASIBILITY.md)

upstream.description: Reference C implementation of Argon2 (Password Hashing Competition winner)

license.selected: CC0-1.0 OR Apache-2.0 (dual-licensed upstream; both branches honoured)
license.notice_obligation: The Apache-2.0 branch requires attribution/NOTICE preservation; the CC0-1.0 branch imposes no conditions. LICENSE is vendored verbatim and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md records the component.

excluded_files.reason: Not required for the library build; excluded to minimise the vendored surface and avoid shipping unrelated binaries, tooling and documentation artefacts.
excluded_files.note_opt_c: src/opt.c is the x86 SSE2 optimised fill_segment. OHOS arm64 and x86_64 builds use src/ref.c (portable). Including opt.c on arm64 produces 'undefined reference to fill_segment' (observed in HARMONY_ARGON2_FEASIBILITY.md section 3.2). Shipping only ref.c removes a class of architecture-conditional mistakes.

local_modifications.statement: Every vendored file is byte-identical to the upstream tarball. Verified by SHA-256 comparison of each vendored file against its upstream counterpart (see tools/harmony/check-third-party-hashes.mjs). No patch is applied at vendoring time.

build_notes.symbol_export: libargon2 is linked STATICALLY into the NAPI module. -DA2_VISCTL=1 is deliberately NOT defined: in include/argon2.h A2_VISCTL makes ARGON2_PUBLIC expand to visibility("default"), which would re-export the whole argon2_* API from the shared object. Leaving ARGON2_PUBLIC empty and relying on -fvisibility=hidden keeps argon2_* out of the dynamic symbol table; only the NAPI entry point (RegisterPdiArgon2Module) carries default visibility. Verified: with -DA2_VISCTL=1, 22 argon2_* symbols are exported; without it, 0.
build_notes.threading: src/thread.c enabled (OHOS provides pthread); parallelism 1..4 exercised by the host and cross-build gates.
